bio.text: Charlie Hatcher, a veterinarian and former Tennessee agriculture commissioner under Gov. Bill Lee, won the Republican nomination for Tennessee's 5th Congressional District in the August 2026 primary, defeating incumbent Rep. Andy Ogles.
According to his campaign website, he served as Tennessee State Veterinarian before becoming Commissioner of Agriculture.

The Williamson Herald describes him as a Williamson County resident and fifth-generation dairy farmer who is a livestock veterinarian and a former member of the University of Tennessee board of trustees.
